spec.name: Orange Kitchen Vegetable Dumplings
spec.description: Three plump, ivory-gold vegetable dumplings on a low bamboo tray. Stepped shoulders, raised dough pleats and pinched crowns create a readable silhouette, with tiny onion-green filling glimpses and restrained soy-brown accents. Tray rests at y=0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Vegetable Dumplings. Three pleated dumplings on a small bamboo tray. Shaped dough folds and a clear pinched top. Actual recipe ingredients: dough, soy, onion. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
